title: Heterogeneous biased total influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p=(p_i)_{i=0}^{n-1}$ be a sequence of real numbers with $0<p_i<1$ for every $i$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\}^n$. The heterogeneous biased total influence of $f$ at bias vector $p$ is the sum, over all coordinates $i$, of the heterogeneous biased influence of $f$ in coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: Each bias parameter $p_i$ lies strictly between $0$ and $1$
$f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
